name: How long does it take to repair water damage from a wall leak?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair water damage from a wall leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of water damage repair from a wall leak depends on the extent of the damage, the source of the leak, and how quickly remediation begins. Minor leaks might be resolved in a few days of drying and repair. More extensive damage involving mold growth, structural repairs, or significant demolition can take several weeks. A professional restoration company will provide an estimated timeline after a thorough assessment of your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from days for minor leaks to several weeks for extensive damage, depending on severity and promptness of action.
